response.sql: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS state_total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT state_total, 1.0 * state_total / NULLIF(SUM(state_total) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_totals), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.state_total) AS combined_transaction_total, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM state_shares s CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE s.share > b.average_share

assumptions.assumption: A state with eligible transactions but no recorded amounts has a total of zero and participates in the average. If the grand total is zero, shares are undefined and the result contains NULL values.
